tasks.title: Conversation #25
tasks.transcript:
WOMAN: Jason, what are you planning to do this evening? Some of us are going
to see a movie together.
MAN: I've got tickets to see a baseball game tonight.
WOMAN: Oh, that sounds like a lot of fun. I hope you enjoy it. By the way, have you finished the report yet?
MAN: I've written everything and checked it for mistakes, but I need to insert a couple of graphs. I should be done with that in ten minutes.
WOMAN: Great. Would you e-mail me a copy when you're finished, please?
MAN: Of course. That’s not a problem at all.

questions.stem: Why does the man say, “I've got tickets to see a baseball game tonight”?

options.A: To request some time off from work.
options.C: To ask the woman to go with him.
options.D: To explain why he is leaving early.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问男士为什么说“我今晚有棒球赛的门票”，属于推理判断题，需结合女士之前的邀请来理解这句话的言外之意。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中没有提到男士需要请假，他只是在说明自己晚上的安排，属于无中生有。 选项B：正确。 女士邀请男士晚上一起去看电影（Some of us are going to see a movie together），男士回应说自己有棒球赛的门票，暗示他无法接受邀请，即婉拒了女士的邀请。 选项C：错误。 男士没有邀请女士一起去看棒球赛，他只是说明自己的安排，属于过度推断。 选项D：错误。 对话中没有提到男士要提前离开，他只是在回应晚上的活动安排，属于无关信息。

questions.stem: What does the woman ask the man to do?

options.B: Begin working on a new project.
options.C: Speak to someone in the Graphics Department.
options.D: Send her a copy of a completed assignment.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问女士请男士做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住对话末尾女士提出的明确请求。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 对话中提到的是报告（report），而非预算（budget），属于张冠李戴。 选项B：错误。 男士已经基本完成了报告，女士没有要求他开始一个新项目，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到图形部门（Graphics Department），属于与原文无关的干扰项。 选项D：正确。 女士明确说“Would you e-mail me a copy when you're finished, please?”，即请男士完成报告后给她发一份电子副本。
